## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `34a97c480a5741169728b67d5911a1b67b7f5c75`

Written 2026-09-21T10:00Z — the at-tier, adversarial contract review for card #19570 on PR #19575, in the R5 shape: the diff and the card were read, check conclusions are taken from the head's check-runs, and the only local run was `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (plus `git grep`, `git merge-tree`, `awk`). Tier H (`.claude/**`): the maintainer merges by hand. This is the review of record, ⛔ not a landing record.

### ① Derived judgments

**1. Scope — RIGHT.** `git diff origin/main...34a97c48 --name-status` = M `SKILL.md`, M `references/core-rules.md`, A `references/filing-gate.md`, M `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`; four files, +80/−9. The ratchet hunk adds exactly two rows for the new file (`CEILINGS` at 61, `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` at 0) and nothing else; no other entry's ceiling moved (the script's own summary line `declared cross-file moves: 1, total ceilings down 9 lines` is unchanged from main). Adding that row is the ratchet's own contract, not a new instrument: its header defines the covered surface as an ENUMERATION of 「the pm-dispatch surface (SKILL.md, its references/, the per-lane job descriptions)」 and says to read a file's absence 「as a fact to check, not an oversight to infer」, so a new `references/` file without a row is the header's own named gap — and the card requires the ratchet paid on its text. (Noted, not a finding: `references/instrument-discipline.md` from #19513 sits on main with no row.) The merge commit `cf5f2245` has parents `c7cca670` (branch) and `b3615f1a` (origin/main, after #19513 at `3e8e2b0d`); its diff against the main-side parent touches only the four PR files. `git merge-tree b3615f1a c7cca670` reproduces one conflict, in SKILL.md at the Acceptance-notes lines — main's 「只报告的仪器,报错不配 dev:猜意图的只印读数,误报席位一句推翻,⛔ 不立卡不派 dev。」 against the branch's compressed 「Acceptance notes 前先答「哪个 PR 或人会碰到它」;答不出 ⇒ 仍然关,理由写「承接者:无」。」 — resolved by keeping both (SKILL.md:360-:361 at the head), plus the one resolution-adjacent edit the body names: `filing-gate.md:19` went from 「既不派 dev,今亦不立卡」 to 「(不派 dev 见 `references/instrument-discipline.md`)」.

**2. Part A, the door — WRONG: the six rules are present and faithful, the reconciliation is not.** In `references/filing-gate.md`:
- Rule 1 — :14 「立卡只为四类,正文首行写出类别字母;⛔ 其余一律不立卡,不论它叫什么。」; :15-:18 carry (a) 具名落点或复现的产品缺陷, (b) 只有维护者能做的决定 with 速读 + 四棱块, (c) 维护者直派的任务,正文引其原话, (d) 协调节点:跨仓/跨层父单与它的逐层子单. `SKILL.md:351-:352` is the door and its pointer inside 〈分诊座位职责〉.
- Rule 2 — :19-:24, all six named non-cards: instrument misfire (:19, pointing at `instrument-discipline.md`), seat's own mistake/observation (:20), :21 「⛔ 不是卡:三类外的 `finding` —— 原为首触即关,今门前即拒。」, :22 「⛔ 不是卡:丢卡重建,除非它自身即 (a)–(d)。」, pointer/notice a comment can carry (:23), sweep-derived pin/bump/hygiene (:24).
- Rule 3 — :25 「每次 POST 之前正文答三件:类别字母、动手的读者(哪个席位哪一步)、查重词与命中数。」, :26 「缺任一件的卡由分诊首触即关、不定级,关单一行点名缺的是哪一件。」; twin `core-rules.md:80`.
- Rule 4 — :29 「配额:一席每 fire 至多立三张;sweep 超出的折进一张带清单的卡,或折进座位贴。」, :30 「分诊席的存量清理仍走维护者确认的十张一组,⛔ 不因本门改批量。」.
- Rule 5 — :31 「写节奏 ⛔ 非可选:REST 写(评论/标签/关单/立卡)间隔 ≥3 秒,每账号每小时 ≤40 笔。」, :32 (429 or secondary limit ⇒ that seat stops writing for the fire, recorded on the seat post), :33 「关单 ⛔ 永不由脚本循环连发:须维护者确认的分组,且逐笔之间留间隔。」; `SKILL.md:99` carries the invariant. Stated as seat discipline: no line claims a script enforces the numbers, and none of the four 「Not in this card」 items appears (no throttle, no `label-write` refusal, no `filed.log`, no backup status — grep over the diff: 0 hits).
- Rule 6 — :34 「立卡、开 PR 与评论恒走 App 安装身份(`claude[bot]`),⛔ 不走席位用户令牌。」, :35 「用户类写绑作者:封号则其卡与评论按作者 404,故一个 fire 的首写回读 `user.type`。」, :36 「读到 `User` ⇒ 记座位贴、本 fire ⛔ 不立新卡;认领仍靠 assignee,署名仍是文本的 session ID。」; `SKILL.md:99` 「写侧恒走 `claude[bot]` ⛔ 不走用户令牌;…」. Faithful to the briefed sixth rule, consequence included.

What is WRONG — the door lands beside four surviving lines that contradict it, and nothing reconciles them:
- `SKILL.md:187` 「立卡者不查重、只附 3–5 查重词;真撞上重复,先比数值与作用域再决定关哪个。」 is the opposite of rule 3 (the filer runs the dedupe query and writes the hit count). And `core-rules.md:80` WAS rewritten to the door's wording (「立卡者只答类别/读者/查重命中数」) while its SKILL.md twin :187 was not — against `SKILL.md:42` 「一条规则在本文与核心条款一处改动,另一处同 PR 同改。」.
- `SKILL.md:241` 「任何跨座位请求都是工作(要读数、要开卡、要授权):一律立卡进目标车道队列。」 and :242 「⛔ 座位贴敲门或裁决评论永不作跨座位请求的唯一载体;评论是加速器不是记录。」, twin `core-rules.md:61` 「跨座位请求即立卡进目标车道,…」, versus `filing-gate.md:23` 「⛔ 不是卡:既有卡一条评论能承载的指针/知会/请求 —— 评论是加速器不是记录。」. A request for a reading or an authorization is none of (a)–(d), so :241 orders a card the door refuses; and :23 reuses :242's phrase with its meaning inverted (:242 uses it to REQUIRE the card).
- `SKILL.md:310` 「顺带发现 ⇒ 独立立单进修复落地仓,附查重词;⛔ 不借 sub-issue 通道塞未分诊卡进池子。」 — under the door an incidental finding is a card only when it is (a); the line says always, and 「附查重词」 is the pre-door protocol again (so is `SKILL.md:785` 「…实属三类的补立、归挂、附查重词」).
- `core-rules.md:87` 「立卡限三类:今日可达可复现缺陷、契约违背、具名生产者陷阱;…」 sits three lines under the new :84 「立卡门四类外 ⛔ 不立卡;…」 — two counts of what may be filed in one section, with no line saying the three are the inside of (a). The same at `SKILL.md:351-:354`, where the door's (a)(b)(c)(d) and `finding`'s (a)(b)(c) share letters with different meanings and 「正文首行写类别字母」 does not say which set.
The old `finding` first-touch lines ARE reconciled (`SKILL.md:390` 「三类外首触关闭只清门前存量,关 not planned(不等批准可否决重开);三类内无证据拒收。」; :374 unchanged and compatible). The remedy is in-place rewrites of :187, :241/:242, :310 (and :785), `core-rules.md:87` — rewrites, not additions, so headroom 0 is no obstacle.

**3. Part B — RIGHT.** Every measured gap is carried, in the charter's own register: false green `filing-gate.md:43` 「假绿另有条款:绿线被读作「已核对」而实际没核对 ⇒ 一次人眼捕获即一次实测代价。」; four answers not two :44-:45 (「假红的标准代价形态是席位顺从它」, one named seat action on one named card counts as a mis-dispatch); chain inheritance :46 「沿链继承只给上界,界内哪格由失效形态定:墙齐平,税降一格;可重入队的 PR 是税。」; the three-state checklist :40-:42 with state ② 「补步骤并继承该项档 ⛔ 不降 p3」 and the pointer `SKILL.md:373`; North Star item 4 :47 (shipped faces only, ⛔ 不含 `.claude/**`) and :48 (「一句说错的话,⛔ 不是一句缺席的话」); premise re-read `SKILL.md:365` 「入决策箱那一笔连「前提今天还成立吗」一起现读;改状态只需现读卡。」; retriage by content `SKILL.md:400` 「retriage 的异议判据认内容(有评论写明所求)⛔ 不认形状(有一条异议评论)。」; zero-with-control and control-proves-reach are the pre-existing `SKILL.md:167-:169` (extended by the :170 pointer, not restated) with exact-not-prefix at :60; reach radius, both arms :52-:54 (半径内 zero is a zero; the shipped-face list incl. 墓碑处方, 拒绝消息, CHANGELOG, 协议的接受/拒绝行为; 「点不出受害者」⛔ 不是证据) and both corollaries :55 (「辅助面」⛔ 不蕴含「可关」) and :56 (落点在半径内 ⛔ 不蕴含所护的在内); git-ignored directory :59 and the three-part zero :57-:58; one enumeration per fire :61 「全板枚举每 fire 至多一次,⛔ 不反复实扫;统计走 `board-archive` 离线做,巡查按日。」.

**4. Ratchet and the seven deleted lines — RIGHT.** `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` at the head: exit 0; `SKILL.md is 819 lines (ceiling 819; headroom 0)`, `core-rules.md is 151 lines (ceiling 151; headroom 0)`, `filing-gate.md is 61 lines (ceiling 61; headroom 0)`, every other entry unchanged. The seven SKILL.md deletions each have a survivor: ①② the two 两级盘点 cadence lines merge into :322 with both limbs intact; ③④⑤ the three Acceptance-notes lines become :361 plus `filing-gate.md:27-:28` (the 「说不出的形态」 list restored at 34a97c4); ⑥ 「清单项会 fail 才算断…」 becomes `filing-gate.md:40` (the 「有人在等」 limb) and :42 (the 「缺项补账本」 limb) behind the :373 pointer; ⑦ 「每批先验三类…」 becomes :390 with all three limbs. No rule was deleted without a survivor. Line lengths (`awk 'length($0) 大于 120'`, table rows excluded): only `SKILL.md:818` (172 B — the claim template inside a code fence, pre-existing on main at :815) and `filing-gate.md:10` (211 B — the maintainer's verbatim blockquote, a `quotation` exemption in the ratchet's own classifier); no new rule line exceeds 120 B.

**5. Language and register — RIGHT, with two notes.** Charter lines are Chinese, one rule per line; the door's numbers are written the way the charter writes others (三张 / 十张一组 / ≥3 秒 / ≤40 笔, cf. :84's 十五张 / 五张). The id-lint pattern (hash followed by three or more digits) over the three files: 0 hits. Notes for the maintainer's eye, neither a FAIL item: (i) provenance costs five lines (:8-:12, a dated header and two blockquotes) where the ratchet header's convention is 「provenance is one line」 and `instrument-discipline.md:11` on main is one line; the bare 「19546」 inside the quote is the maintainer's own sentence kept verbatim, as AGENTS.md requires. (ii) The card named `references/platform-readings.md` as a landing file; the PR lands the reading criteria in the new file instead, with a measurement (469/469, no adjacent bullet pair merges under 120 B) — a declared deviation. The per-fire read grows by 65 lines (new file 61 + SKILL.md 815→819) under a card that said 「Ratchet paid in place」; the precedent is #19513's 11-line file from this morning.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` on the claim (5758101147), the PR body and the report — consistent; no changeset, nothing under `packages/**`, and `skip-changeset` is the correct label for a diff that publishes nothing. Carriers: none hung — `needs:contract-review` is on neither the PR (labels: `documentation`, `size/s`, `skip-changeset`) nor the card (`tooling`, `priority:p1`, `pm:dispatched`, `domain:skills`).

### ③ Boundary flags

- CI, read from the head's check-runs at 2026-09-21T09:57Z — the seven required contexts: `Lint & Repo Gates` in_progress = NOT MEASURED; `TypeScript Type Check` success; `Test Core` aggregate in_progress = NOT MEASURED (shards 1/6–6/6 all success); `Dogfood Regression Gate` success; `Build Core` skipped (expected: ci.yml's `filter` job routes it by path); `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` skipped (expected); `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success. The PR workflows do fire on a `.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**` diff: `lint.yml` and `ci.yml` carry an unfiltered `pull_request:` trigger, and `scripts/**` is in ci.yml's `crosspkg` filter list. Advisory: `Check Changeset` failed once before the label and is `skipped` on its re-run.
- `skip-changeset` was written by `os-project-manager` at 2026-09-21T09:48Z — the director's act, not the dev's (the report lists no label write); `documentation` and `size/s` are Auto Label's.
- PR state: draft, `auto_merge` null, head repo = base repo (not a fork), `mergeable_state: blocked`. Tier H by `.claude/**`: no ready, no queue, no auto-merge from any seat; the maintainer's hand.
- Dev open question 1 (the PR row was created under `user.type = User`): answer A — the branch at 34a97c48 is the durable artefact and rule 6's own consequence line (:36) is exactly this case; the report records the reading; do not re-create the PR.
- Dev open question 2 (`claude/issue-19546-grading-contract-amendments` still on origin at cf5f2245, delete refused 403): confirmed by `git ls-remote`; answer A — a seat or the maintainer with ref-delete permission removes it; not a defect of this PR.
- Dev out-of-scope note (`instrument-discipline.md` unratcheted on main): under the door that is a seat observation, not a card; the next `domain:skills` PR touching the map carries it.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-19570-filing-door`
Reviewed-by: `session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`
